name: Pack List
shortDescription: A packing list that checks itself off and shows how full the bag is.
description: A packing list for your own kinds of trips. Pick a weekend, a beach week, a work trip, or a camping trip, or compose two into one list, and the items show up grouped. A bag in the header fills with liquid as you pack, the percentage rolls beside it, and a weight bar warms to amber as you near your airline limit. Swipe a row right to pack it; packed items sink to the bottom of their group. Checks stay in your browser, and Export carries the list to another device.
